map.由名义利率与复利频率求实际年化收益率: Actual Annual Yield from Nominal Rate and Compounding Frequency
map.输入名义年利率 r 与每年复利次数 n，求 APY。: Enter the nominal annual rate r and compounding frequency n per year to find the APY.
map.📖 查看「由名义利率与复利频率求实际年化收益率 使用指南」: View "Actual Annual Yield from Nominal Rate and Compounding Frequency User Guide"
map.APY=(1+r/n)^n−1，r 为名义年利率、n 为每年复利次数；反映不同复: APY=(1+r/n)^n−1, where r is the nominal annual rate and n is the compounding frequency per year; it reflects the true annualized return at different compounding frequencies, which rises with frequency and is capped by continuous compounding e^r−1.
